page: Microsoft Azure FX4-2ms_v2 is a specialized virtual machine configuration providing high per-core memory capacity alongside high single-core processor clock frequencies. The instance allocates 2 dedicated vCPUs spanning a single physical core with two threads on an Intel Xeon 8573C processor capable of reaching 4.2 GHz. The hardware architecture incorporates 260 MB of L3 cache along with instruction extensions including AVX-512 and AMX for advanced matrix calculations. Memory capacity is provisioned at 84.0 GB, delivering 42.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage is included, requiring network-attached storage for persistent workloads, and no hardware GPU accelerators are present.

Benchmark evaluation highlights a pronounced difference between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. In single-core testing, the high processor frequency enables top-tier results, evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 2333.0 and single-threaded gzip compression reaching 34.85 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded throughput is restricted by the single physical core allocation, generating lower-tier results in multi-core Geekbench (2897.0) and PassMark CPU tests (4164.68). Memory subsystem tests register 172.01 GB/sec on small cached blocks, with throughput declining to 21.59 GB/sec read and 14.36 GB/sec write bandwidth on large uncached memory transfers.

Cost efficiency for the FX4-2ms_v2 is tied to its high memory-to-vCPU ratio. Deploying 84.0 GB of memory across just 2 vCPUs provides an effective platform for software stacks licensed on a per-core basis that demand large memory footprints without extensive multi-core parallelism. The instance fits in-memory caching layers, single-threaded analytical processing, financial modelling jobs, and memory-intensive batch pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure FX4-2ms_v2 is a specialized virtual machine designed for high memory density paired with high clock frequency execution. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating up to 4.2 GHz, the instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs across 1 physical core, complete with AVX-512, AMX instructions, and a 260 MB L3 cache. It features 84.0 GB of system memory, providing 42.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, with no local ephemeral storage included. Benchmark results highlight top-tier single-threaded compute capabilities, scoring 2333.0 in Geekbench single-core and delivering strong single-threaded compression throughput. However, overall multi-core scalability is constrained by the two-thread limit, and uncached memory bandwidth remains modest. This configuration provides qualitative cost efficiency for per-core licensed software that requires large memory footprints rather than high parallel core counts, such as specialized in-memory database engines, batch processing, and memory-bound computational pipelines.
